claim: SELPLY returns the player an enemy should hunt: it reads the primary target slot TARPLY, and with no primary registered there is nobody to chase.

source.verbatim: SELPLY	LDX	TARPLY		GET TARGETED PLAYER TO KILL

claim: The spawn-grace gate: a player is targetable ONLY once its delay timer TARTM1 has reached zero (BEQ). A freshly-materialised knight, whose timer is still counting down, cannot be locked onto.

source.verbatim: LDA	TARTM1		DELAY TIMER AT ZERO?

claim: When both players are targetable SELPLY (:4476-4514) does NOT compute a per-player distance: the X-axis metric's high byte is always non-zero so the TSTA/BNE store guard (:4487-4488) never fires and the X store is dead. The choice reads only the primary's Y-distance byte (-(|Dy|)&0xFF) and the secondary's X-metric low byte, left in register B; the final CMPB 1,S / BLO (:4512-4514) keeps the primary only when the secondary's X byte is strictly less (unsigned) than the primary's Y byte, else it falls through to LDX TARPL2 — the secondary (so an exact tie favours the secondary). Decoded by verified 6809 trace (jt9-24); this retires the jt8-1 min-of-axes approximation.
STPLY registers a player into a target slot: the primary TARPLY if it is empty, otherwise the secondary TARPL2.

source.verbatim: STPLY2	LDD	TARPLY		IS THIS SPOT EMPTY?

claim: Registration arms the slot's grace timer from TARTIM (the master targeting delay = 90 frames, JOUSTRV4.SRC:959-960) — the protection is born non-zero, not at zero.

source.verbatim: LDA	TARTIM		GIVE CURRENT TIME DELAY TIME

claim: On the death of the primary target, the secondary is shifted up into the primary slot (TARPL2 into TARPLY, TARTM2 into TARTM1) and the secondary slot is cleared.
Each frame the grace timers decrement toward zero, guarded by a BEQ so a timer already at zero is not decremented (it floors at 0 rather than wrapping to 255).

source.verbatim: LDA	TARTM1		DECREMENT TARGETED PLAYERS TIME

claim: At the wave/game reset both target slots are cleared (TARPLY and TARPL2 set to zero), so no enemy carries a stale target across the boundary.
TARPLY is the primary targeted-player workspace pointer.
TARPL2 is the secondary targeted-player workspace pointer.
TARTIM is the master delay applied to a newly-registered player before an enemy may target it.

source.verbatim: TARTIM	RMB	1	MASTER DELAY BEFORE TARGETING THE PLAYER

claim: TARTM1 is the current grace time left (for the TARPLY player) before the enemy finds it; TARTM2 is the same for TARPL2.

source.verbatim: TARTM1	RMB	1	CURRENT TIME LEFT (FOR "TARPLY") UNTIL FINDING PLAYER

claim: TARTIM, the master targeting delay, is initialised to 90 frames — '1 1/2 SECOND OF DELAY BEFORE TARGETING PLAYER' — the spawn-grace an enemy waits (via the TARTM1/TARTM2 reload) before it may lock onto a freshly-materialised knight (LDA #90 / STA TARTIM).

source.verbatim: LDA	#90		1 1/2 SECOND OF DELAY BEFORE TARGETING PLAYER
